title: Introduce RAG Onramp FastPath: TypeScript + Go plugin playground
author: Ava Martinez
description: Context: Customers repeatedly ask for a small, production-adjacent example that demonstrates (1) lightweight RAG onramps from a browser/edge TS client, (2) FastPath routing to lower-latency model variants, and (3) a language-agnostic tool plugin pattern. This PR adds a compact playground that wires a TypeScript front-end agent into a Go-based tool plugin (gRPC shim) and a docs walkthrough that highlights FastPath routing and telemetry probes. Motivation: many existing examples are full-featured but heavy. We want a minimal, opinionated onramp developers can clone and iterate on quickly. What this PR includes: - TypeScript agent playground (src/ts-playground/) with an opinionated prompt template, streaming SSE shim, and local mock index. - Go tool plugin (plugins/go/search-plugin/) that exposes a simple SearchTool over gRPC; demonstrates safe tool-call handshake and JSON-schema responses. - FastPath router config sample (configs/fastpath.yaml) showing model routing by latency SLO and region preference. - Devcontainer and lightweight docker-compose for local smoke runs (devcontainer.json, docker-compose.yml). - Docs walkthrough and copy for docs.redwood.ai (docs/rag-onramp-fastpath.md) with Live Preview snippets. - CI smoke tests and a small e2e script used in the quickstart (ci/smoke-playground.sh). Checklist: - [x] Minimal TS agent scaffold and README - [x] Go plugin shim + proto + health checks - [x] FastPath routing example config + notes - [x] Devcontainer / docker-compose for one-command run - [x] Docs walkthrough drafted and linked to quickstart index - [x] CI smoke job added to quick checks - [x] Security review notes added (see review thread) Usage summary: 1) git clone && cd redwood-examples/playgrounds/onramp-fastpath 2) ./scripts/local-run.sh 3) open http://localhost:8080 and try the "search" tool from the agent The playground intentionally keeps the index small and uses a permissive CORS dev proxy; do not run this container in production without toggling security knobs documented in docs/rag-onramp-fastpath.md. Related: ENG-2389 (FastPath router prototype), PM-109 (onramp quickstarts), SUP-412 (support case that motivated example). Notes on scope: this PR is an examples + docs addition only; no changes to core runtime or infra. The go plugin demonstrates a recommended pattern (gRPC + JSON-schema payloads) that teams can adopt for custom tools.

notes: This PR is intended as a developer education asset. Product teams can reference the pattern for onramps and plugin tool bindings. The example intentionally avoids production defaults (see docs for hardening checklist).
security_notes: SECURITY: dev playground uses permissive CORS and an unsigned plugin; do not run in prod. SECURITY.md included with recommended hardening steps and a link to internal ENG-Security-18.
